claims.text: UN Women (April 2026): more than 38,000 women and girls killed Oct 2023–Dec 2025, ~47 a day, likely an undercount; close to 11,000 with lifelong injuries; female-headed households rose to 14% (58,600). PCBS: 12,400 women (excluding girls) killed.
Health ministry: about 3,958 miscarriages Jan–Jun 2026, a rate 3.3 times H2 2025; PHR: 220 pregnancy-related deaths and 1,460 premature births (period unclear).
Ministry Oct 2026: anaemia among pregnant women 61% in 2026 vs 41% pre-war; ~4,000 pregnancy losses in H1 2026; one in three pregnancies high-risk.

UNFPA Oct 2025: ~130 births a day, over a quarter by C-section; 55,000 pregnant women without access to care; one in five newborns premature, underweight or with complications; only 15 facilities able to provide obstetric care; Nasser 200 newborns in ICU for 40 places; midwife cut a cord 'with a knife, heated over a fire'.

COI March 2025: Israel 'intentionally attacked and destroyed' Gaza's main fertility centre, Al-Basma, in Dec 2023, destroying ~4,000 embryos, finding no credible evidence of military use; called it a measure to prevent births, a genocidal act; found sexual and gender-based violence including forced public stripping part of 'standard operating procedures'. Israel's mission: 'categorically rejects the unfounded allegations'; Netanyahu: 'absurd claims', Council 'anti-Semitic, corrupt, terror-supporting'.
